content:
For \(n\le 999\), the values stabilize to
\[
f(n)=
\begin{cases}
997,& n\text{ even},\\
998,& n\text{ odd}.
\end{cases}
\]
(Check \(995\)–\(999\), then induct downward.)

Thus \(f(106)=997\), so
\[
f(101)=f(f(106))=f(997)=998.
\]
Since the reflection has \(f(99)=f(101)\), we get
\[
f(99)=998.
\]
Then
\[
f(94)=f(f(99))=f(998)=997,
\]
\[
f(89)=f(f(94))=f(997)=998,
\]
\[
f(84)=f(f(89))=f(998)=997.
\]
Therefore,
\[
\boxed{997}
\]
